Implement EPIC 0 - Sprint 1 for ECAP.

Task:
Create the enterprise Bicep foundation.

Read and follow:
- docs/handbook/epic-0-enterprise-foundation/
- docs/architecture/adr/
- docs/development/

Requirements:
- Create reusable Bicep module structure.
- Create main.bicep.
- Create naming and tagging modules.
- Prepare monitoring modules (Log Analytics and Application Insights).
- Keep modules environment-independent.
- Use parameters instead of hardcoded values.
- Apply standard tags to every resource.
- Include outputs for downstream modules.
- Explain every architectural decision.
- Follow Azure Well-Architected Framework and Azure Verified Module guidance where appropriate.
